source_name: Companies Registry — List of Newly Incorporated / Registered / Re-domiciled Companies (Open Data)
fields_observed: Current Corporate Name / Other Corporate Name
Current Approved Name for Carrying on Business in H.K.
notes: Official CR open data on data.gov.hk (CKAN). Weekly CSV/XLS files in the RNC063 series: RNC063L = newly incorporated LOCAL companies (and name changes); RNC063F = newly registered NON-HONG-KONG companies (and name changes). Verified live: RNC063L_20241230.csv = 3,286 rows. Fields: Seq, English name, Chinese name, BR Number (IRD Business Registration number, 8-digit), Date of Incorporation/Registration (DD-MM-YYYY), Date of Change of name. NO personal data in this feed (company-level only). INCREMENTAL feed — not the full register. Identifier here is the BR Number, NOT the CR Company Number.

source_name: Companies Registry — ICRIS e-Search (Integrated Companies Registry Information System)
notes: The authoritative full company register (ICRIS3EP e-Search). Holds the CR Company Number plus full particulars (type, status, registered office, directors, secretary, charges, documents). Interactive portal (303 redirect / session). Document and image search and full particulars are PAY-PER-USE; no open bulk or free API. Directors/secretary are natural persons (PDPO). Field model from public documentation only; no values captured.

HKEX List of Securities (listed stocks). The static .xlsx URL returned a TEMPLATE skeleton for automated requests (placeholders <<TableContent>>/<<nextTradeDate>>, dimension A1:R8) — the populated list is generated server-side. Listed-securities identity (stock code, name, ISIN) is browser-public but not cleanly available via this static URL for automation. Listed companies only.

organization: Office of the Government Chief Information Officer (OGCIO)
notes: National open-data portal (CKAN package_search works). A q=company search returns 12 datasets; the only company-register dataset is the Companies Registry RNC063 feed above. Other results are statistics (Census & Statistics, Official Receiver). Use the CKAN API to enumerate the weekly RNC063 resource URLs.
